newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Mid-August listing planned for Oceanfast.
newsitem.headline: Mid-August listing planned for Oceanfast.

text.p: Commercial vessel and luxury motor yacht manufacturer Oceanfast Ltd said it expected to list on the Australian Stock Exchange around August 15.
The company is offering 11 million shares at 50 cents each, out of a total 22 million shares on issue, to raise A$5.5 million. The issue is underwritten by brokerage William Noall.
Sales revenue for the year ended June 30, 1998 was forecast to be A$57.11 million, with earnings before interest and tax forecast at A$5.12 million and net profit at A$3.28 million.
